description: Batch version of client meeting prep: given a list of the day's meetings (client description + optional topic + optional time each), returns a compact prep briefing for every meeting in one call — matched topic, 2 key terms, one sourced opener fact, and a risk-alignment snapshot if a risk tolerance was mentioned. No calendar access — the advisor supplies the meeting list directly.

client_description.description: Client background, interests, or context for this meeting

time.description: Optional meeting time, for display/ordering only

name: advisor.daily_prep
title: Prep for a Day of Client Meetings
